description: Batch zinc-site prediction with viewable protein structures and downloadable PyMOL sessions. ZincSight: Mechtinger et al., Protein Science (2025).
functions: Upload multiple PDB/mmCIF structures together, or upload a ZIP/TAR archive. Each job accepts up to 100 structures, 5 MB per uncompressed structure and 100 MB total; each first model must contain 3–4,000 standard protein residues. Supply structures, a batch archive, or both.

One row per input in the Structures result opens its first-model structure, including inputs with no predicted sites. PDB/mmCIF exports retain original atoms and experimental ions and add clearly annotated predicted-site markers.

Download a PyMOL .pse session per input, with separate original atoms, experimental metals, predicted markers and coordinating residues. A complete results ZIP, per-site CSV, prediction JSON and citation files are available in Files.
Predicted Zn markers indicate potential binding-site locations. They do not identify the bound metal; this zinc-trained method can also detect potential Fe, Mn, Co, Cu and Ni sites.

Four vCPUs and 12 GiB memory are allocated per job, with a 3 GiB budget per worker. The whole batch shares one private database and one native ZincSight prediction run. Optional histidine rotamer sampling is enabled by default.

For Colab-style ID input, use the bundled integrations/tamarind/prepare_inputs.py companion on a networked computer and upload its prepared ZIP as the batch archive. It accepts PDB/assembly, UniProt, full AlphaFold model, MGYP and TED domain IDs, including ID-list files. Direct ID downloading in this Tamarind tool page is unavailable.

Please cite: Mechtinger G, Axel G, Kolodny R, Ben-Tal N. Interpretable prediction of zinc ion location in proteins with ZincSight. Protein Science. 2025;34(11):e70350. https://doi.org/10.1002/pro.70350. The Paper link and downloadable CITATION.txt/CITATION.bib files reference this study; Tamarind manages the native Citations tab separately and it may retain its default citation.

Development preview with reproducibility fixes; historical outputs can differ and published accuracy benchmarks have not been re-established for this revision. Predictions are not experimental confirmation of binding, metal selectivity, occupancy or catalytic activity. No predicted sites does not rule out binding.

inputs.name: structures
inputs.descr: Upload one or more PDB/mmCIF structures, or use the batch archive below. Up to 100 inputs, 5 MB each and 100 MB total; 3–4,000 standard protein residues per first model. All chains in that model are analyzed; include side-chain coordinates.

inputs.name: batch_archive
inputs.displayName: Batch archive or prepared ID batch
inputs.descr: Optional ZIP, TAR, TAR.GZ or TGZ containing PDB/mmCIF files, including .pdb.gz/.cif.gz members. For IDs, upload the ZIP produced by the bundled prepare_inputs.py companion. Direct online ID fetching is unavailable in the Tamarind runtime. Supply structures or an archive.

inputs.name: histidine_rotamers
inputs.descr: Enabled by default. Samples alternative histidine side-chain orientations to improve sensitivity, with a possible small increase in false positives. Disable to use the input orientations only.

inputs.name: minimum_probability
inputs.descr: Output filter; 0.0001 matches the notebook cutoff. This cutoff is not a biological confidence threshold.

inputs.name: max_sites
inputs.descr: Whole number from 1 to 100 per input. Returns each structure's highest-probability sites; CSV/JSON record the total qualifying count and whether that structure was truncated.

inputs.name: cpu_workers
inputs.descr: Whole number from 1 to 4. Uses the available CPU and memory allocation, with 3 GiB budgeted per worker. Higher values parallelize the native structure-processing stages; actual speed depends on the batch.

producedOutputs.name: Structures

columns.name: highest_probability
columns.description: Highest returned ZincSight site probability; empty when no sites pass the cutoff. This is not a biological confidence threshold.

columns.name: structure_file
columns.description: Original first-model atoms plus annotated predicted Zn markers. Markers locate potential sites and do not assign the bound metal identity.

producedOutputs.descr: One row per input, including zero-site results, with a viewable structure and downloadable PyMOL session.

producedOutputs.name: Structures with predicted sites
producedOutputs.descr: First-model protein structures retaining original atoms and ions, with annotated predicted-site Zn markers.

producedOutputs.name: Predicted sites
producedOutputs.descr: All returned sites across the batch, linked to their input structure IDs.
